selection: min Wilson lower bound 2019-2022 and 2023-2024; n>=150/100. 2025 excluded from ranking. At most 2 events/day, >=60 minutes apart.
area_vs_confirmed: AREA is pre-touch; CONFIRMED is next M1 open after completed M1/M5 rejection. Do not call confirmed performance pre-touch probability.
cost_limit: Spread proxy uses entry-minute spread, not true broker bid/ask execution; not net trading win rate.
